A VPN is a private tunnel for your internet traffic. Your connection goes through an encrypted link to another computer before reaching websites, so people on the same network can't read what you send.

Websites see that other computer's location instead of yours. This helps on public Wi-Fi, and when you want to hide your city or reach content from another region.

It isn't total privacy, though. The VPN company can still see your activity, so pick one you trust. It also won't protect you from scams or harmful downloads.

ਵੈੱਬਸਾਈਟ ਨੂੰ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਥਾਂ ਦੀ ਬਜਾਏ ਉਸ ਕੰਪਿਊਟਰ ਦੀ ਲੋਕੇਸ਼ਨ ਦਿਸਦੀ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਪਬਲਿਕ ਵਾਈ-ਫਾਈ 'ਤੇ, ਜਾਂ ਹੋਰ ਇਲਾਕੇ ਦਾ ਕੰਟੈਂਟ ਦੇਖਣ ਲਈ ਕੰਮ ਆਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
